_note: Documentation/config manifest for the Assettype migration of Namma Krishi Prices. Hosted base (settled): https://images.assettype.com/prajavani/. Assettype assigns every uploaded file its own generated URL (date/hash segments), so each value below is a variable-path placeholder: replace <cms-entry-path>/<file> with the real generated URL for the uploaded file. This file is reference material; the app does not read it at runtime.
assetUrlMapNote: Image URLs CANNOT be derived from local filenames. Assettype inserts date/hash segments into every generated URL, so the local name (e.g. tomato-thumb-real.png) does not appear in the hosted URL. Production must maintain an explicit map from each local asset to its real generated URL (see asset-map.example.json).

entry.html: NOT HOSTED AS AN ASSETTYPE OBJECT — paste cms-migration/index.html into the CMS as the page body/snippet; only its referenced JS/CSS/assets live on Assettype.

assets.note: Every image (168 assets: thumbnails, logos, icons, category badges) is a separately uploaded Assettype object with its own generated URL. Production must replace each value in asset-map.example.json with the real generated URL; app.js must be rewritten to reference those absolute URLs (no ./assets/ relative paths survive on the CMS page).

uploadDependencies.note: These payloads are not copied into cms-migration/; they must be uploaded to Assettype separately, each file as its own object, and the generated URL of each recorded in the asset map and hosted app.js/styles.css rewrite.
